mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id AS loginId, password_hash AS passwordHash, role, agency_id AS agencyId, agency_employee_num AS employeeNum, is_locked AS isLocked, is_deleted AS isDeleted, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM platform_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_user ( login_id, password_hash, role, agency_id, agency_employee_num, is_locked, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{agencyId}, #{employeeNum}, #{isLocked}, #{isDeleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
